title: MONTH_18 — Medical History
description: Doctor visits, hospital attendance, symptoms, iron-related items and the restless-legs questions for the last 6 months, from the 18-month questionnaire.
$comment: Most items are coded 1 = yes, 2 = no with no 999; the restless-legs items rls_5, rls_8, rls_9a and rls_9b give a '999 = don't know' (without 'prefer not to answer') and are inlined with the source's own label.
